review.notes: All 23 bilingual entries read in full. Recovery preserves singular/stack distinctions, night search and next-morning mailbox delivery. Native SocialPage chooses housemate labels from NPC gender, so both Greek articles are explicit. Cinema guest wrapper is neutral; cursed-doll line avoids unsupported speaker/player gender. Krobus secrecy, timing and tokens preserved. Void Ghost Pendant wording recorded for later item consistency.
